Title: NEPTUN - Air raid Alert
Desc: NEPTUN is a Ukrainian platform for real-time monitoring of air alerts and threats, created for the safety of Ukrainian citizens. The project operates 24/7, collecting, analyzing and visualizing information about air alerts, the movement of shaheeds, missiles and other threats on an interactive map. Adapted for Lively Wallpaper by FullyRealist
Author: NEPTUN & FullyRealist
